quotes.quote: To evaluate the text generation capabilities of LLMs, we introduce two internal benchmarks: LengthCtrl and InsCtrl.
InsCtrl assesses a model’s proficiency in accurately interpreting and executing complex textual instructions.
LengthCtrl measures the ability of a model to precisely adhere to predefined output length constraints
Proficiency in instruction comprehension and adherence is evaluated through standardized benchmarks such as IFEval (Zhou et al., 2023) and SysBench (Qin et al., 2024).

2025-06-26 Hunyuan-A13B Technical Report Tencent Hunyuan Team
We present Hunyuan-A13B, an open-source large language model
The architecture leverages 80 billion total parameters while activating only 13 billion parameters during inference, enabling cost-effective deployment without compromising capability.
Hunyuan-A13B is designed with a Sparse Mixture-of-Experts architecture comprising 80 billion total parameters, yet activating only 13 billion parameters per input.
The fast-thinking mode provides concise, efficient outputs ideal for simpler tasks requiring speed and minimal computational overhead.

In contrast, the slow-thinking mode involves deeper, more comprehensive reasoning steps such as reflection and backtracking, leading to longer CoT and increased token use, which substantially improves accuracy and robustness in handling complex reasoning tasks.
If no control tag is provided, the system defaults to the slow-thinking mode.
2025.6.27 We have open-sourced Hunyuan-A13B-Pretrain , Hunyuan-A13B-Instruct , Hunyuan-A13B-Instruct-FP8 , Hunyuan-A13B-Instruct-GPTQ-Int4 on Hugging Face.

In addition, we have released a technical report and a training and inference operation manual, which provide detailed information about the model’s capabilities as well as the operations for training and inference.
Hunyuan-A13B-Instruct has achieved highly competitive performance across multiple benchmarks, particularly in mathematics, science, agent domains, and more.

Our model defaults to using slow-thinking reasoning, and there are two ways to disable CoT reasoning.
Hybrid Reasoning Support : Supports both fast and slow thinking modes, allowing users to flexibly choose according to their needs.
Ultra-Long Context Understanding : Natively supports a 256K context window, maintaining stable performance on long-text tasks.

Compact yet Powerful : With only 13 billion active parameters (out of a total of 80 billion), the model delivers competitive performance on a wide range of benchmark tasks, rivaling much larger models.
Tencent Hunyuan A13B (short as Hunyuan-A13B), an innovative and open-source LLM built on a fine-grained MoE architecture.
